name: Can I clean up fire and smoke damage myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I clean up fire and smoke damage myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor smoke damage might seem manageable, comprehensive fire and smoke damage cleanup is best handled by professionals. Smoke and soot residues are highly acidic and corrosive, potentially causing irreversible damage if not treated correctly. Improper cleaning can also spread soot and embed odors further into materials. Furthermore, there might be hidden structural damage or hazardous air quality issues that require expert assessment and specialized equipment. Professional restorers have the training, tools, and protective gear to ensure a safe and thorough restoration, preventing long-term problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional cleanup is recommended for fire and smoke damage due to corrosive residues, hidden hazards, and the need for specialized equipment and techniques.
